mapper.sql: c.id, c.layer_scope, c.bore_code, c.crimp_diameter_mm, c.die_no, c.strip_length_mm, c.insert_depth_mm, c.press_gear, c.shop_can_crimp, c.remark, s.nickname, s.inch
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT bore_code, MIN(nickname) AS nickname, MIN(inch) AS inch FROM wms_hose_spec GROUP BY bore_code ) s ON s.bore_code = c.bore_code
mapper.select:
SELECT FROM wms_hose_crimp c
ORDER BY FIELD(c.layer_scope, '1层/2层', '3层', '4层', '6层'), CAST(c.bore_code AS UNSIGNED)

SELECT FROM wms_hose_crimp c
WHERE c.layer_scope = #{layerScope} AND c.bore_code = #{boreCode} LIMIT 1
